intro: A sandstorm has buried the secrets of the pyramids. Help the scribes uncover them!
To fix it, we need to really learn about The Pyramids of Ancient Egypt.
Study at each place, talk to my friends, and explain what you learn!
story.goal: Learn the three big ideas of The Pyramids of Ancient Egypt to wake The Great Pyramid.
story.finale: You remembered it all! The Great Pyramid shines again thanks to you.

companion.name: Scarab
companion.greeting: Hi, I'm Scarab! I'll help you if you get stuck. Let's explore!

zones.name: The Great Pyramid
zones.description: It wakes up when you master The Pyramids of Ancient Egypt.

npcs.name: Neferi
npcs.title: the Scribe
npcs.persona: Careful, proud scribe who loves writing and stories. Teaches "Tombs for Kings" from the lesson "The Pyramids of Ancient Egypt".
npcs.greeting: Hello there! I'm Neferi. Want to learn about pharaoh with me?
teach: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids as tombs for their kings, who were called pharaohs.
The Great Pyramid of Giza was built for the pharaoh Khufu more than 4,500 years ago.
They believed a pharaoh needed a safe resting place and treasures for the afterlife.

npcs.name: Bako
npcs.title: the Builder
npcs.persona: Strong, hard-working builder who explains things step by step. Teaches "Building with Stone" from the lesson "The Pyramids of Ancient Egypt".
npcs.greeting: Hello there! I'm Bako. Want to learn about blocks with me?
teach: They built long ramps of mud brick to raise the blocks higher and higher.
They dragged the blocks on wooden sledges, and pouring water on the sand in front of the sledge made it easier to pull.
Workers cut huge blocks of limestone from quarries.

npcs.greeting: Hello there! I'm Dr. Dune. Want to learn about hieroglyphs with me?
